title: Green Rewards Card: Carbon Offset Programs and Options
summary: Explains Green Rewards Card environmental offsets: automatic CO₂ offset is $0.06 pounds per $1 spent, shown in the environmental dashboard and period report after transactions clear. Also covers the tree-planting option (1 tree per $3,000 eligible spend, with partial progress), sustainability settings to choose carbon projects/tree/blend (changes apply to spend that posts after update), and how to review project transparency plus certificates/attestations.
faqs: How much CO₂ is offset per dollar spent on the Green Rewards Card?
When do offsets appear in the environmental dashboard and period report?
How many trees are planted under the tree-planting option, and what counts toward the $3,000 threshold?
Can I change my sustainability settings to switch between carbon projects, tree planting, or a blend? When do changes take effect?
What project information (region, project type, verification standards) can I review for active offsets?
Where can I access certificates or attestations for the offsets for my records?
keywords: Carbon projects vs tree planting vs blend
